title: Reishi Relax Gummies
body_html:
Reishi Relax Gummies deliver a blend of functional mushrooms and botanical ingredients traditionally valued for supporting relaxation and emotional well-being. The formula features reishi mushroom extract, widely recognized in traditional practices for helping the body maintain balance and support normal relaxation. It is complemented by L-theanine, lemon balm, passion flower, and valerian root — ingredients commonly used to support a calm and balanced state of mind.

These blackberry-flavored gummies offer a convenient and enjoyable alternative to capsules or teas. The chewable format makes it simple to incorporate relaxation support into your daily wellness routine. Whether you’re winding down after a long day, preparing for a restful evening, or simply seeking moments of calm during a busy schedule, these gummies provide an easy and pleasant option.

Reishi Relax Gummies are ideal for students, busy professionals, and individuals navigating demanding or high-stress lifestyles. Many people turn to calming botanicals and adaptogenic mushrooms as part of their daily routine to help support relaxation and a healthy response to occasional stress. With their thoughtfully selected ingredients and convenient gummy format, these gummies offer a modern way to support everyday calm and overall wellness.*


Ingredients: Reishi Extract (200 mg), L-Theanine (25 mg), Lemon Balm (25 mg), Passion Flower (25 mg), Valerian Root (25 mg), Organic Cane Sugar, Tapioca Syrup, Purified Water, Citrus Pectin, Citric Acid, Blackberry Natural Flavor, Sodium Citrate, Color from Blackberries.
Manufacturer's country: USA
Product amount (oz/lbs/g): 30 gummies / 4.8 oz / 0.3 lbs / 136 g
Gross weight (oz/lbs/g): 5.9 oz / 0.4 lbs / 167g
Suggested use: Take one (1) to two (2) gummies daily.
Warning: Do not exceed recommended dose. Pregnant or nursing mothers, children under the age of 18, and individuals with a known medical condition should consult a physician before using this or any dietary supplement.KEEP OUT OF REACH OF CHILDREN. DO NOT USE IF SAFETY SEAL IS DAMAGED OR MISSING. STORE IN A COOL, DRY PLACE.

*These statements have not been evaluated by the Food and Drug Administration. This product is not intended to diagnose, treat, cure or prevent any disease.
